title: Roadkit roadmap
description: One roadmap rendered by the Roadkit UI. Semantic rules (unique ids, anchors, phase order) are enforced by `python3 tools/roadkit.py check`.

id.description: Unique slug; also the key for saved progress. Never change it after use.

eyebrow.description: Small uppercase line above the title.

language.description: UI language pack in src/labels/ (pt-BR, en). Default pt-BR.

brand.description: Sidebar logo: plain text + accent-colored suffix.

tagline.description: Sidebar text under the logo. \n = line break.

startDate.description: Day the roadmap starts (YYYY-MM-DD). With it, phase periods and topic times become due dates. Users can set their own start in the app.

labels.description: Overrides for UI strings. Keys are listed in src/labels/pt-BR.json.

phases.description: Optional. Ordered stages of the roadmap. Omit for a flat list.

milestone.description: Checkpoint shown after the phase's last core node; turns green when the phase is complete.

due.description: Target day for the phase (YYYY-MM-DD). Wins over the date computed from the period.

nodes.description: Main topics (no parent, not optional) form the vertical path, in order, grouped by phase. Sub-topics and optional topics hang from a parent and branch to the right, up to 2 levels deep.

phase.description: Phase id. Required on main topics when the roadmap defines phases; sub-topics inherit their parent's.

success.description: How to know it is done.

status.description: Initial column in the kanban. Default: derived from the tasks, or todo.

tasks.description: Optional checklist shown as a small kanban inside the card. Finishing the topic finishes every task.

parent.description: Id of the topic this one is a sub-topic of (up to 2 levels below a main topic). A topic with required sub-topics is finished when they all are.

optional.description: Side branch; does not count toward progress or toward its parent. Needs a parent.

anchor.description: Older name for `parent`, used by optional nodes. Prefer `parent`.

due.description: Target day for the topic (YYYY-MM-DD). Wins over the date computed from `time`.

projects.description: Optional hands-on projects, from beginner to advanced, shown in the Projects view. Each one lists the topics it practices.

id.description: Unique among the projects; key of the saved project progress.

uses.description: Node ids this project practices. When all of them are finished, the project is ready to start.

requirements.description: What the project must do, shown as a checklist.

deliverable.description: What to hand in, e.g. 'A repository with a README'.

success.description: How to know it is done.

stretch.description: Optional ideas to go further; they do not count.
